readout_other: laser speckle contrast imaging CBF; cortical width index; adhesive removal test; gelatin-carbon black ink perfusion; CD31 immunofluorescence; TMT proteomics; western blot (ROCK1, p-MLC2)
direction_notes: LIPUS after dMCAO increased CBF, reduced brain swelling, improved functional recovery and vascular remodeling and reduced ROCK1/p-MLC2; neuronal excitation or inhibition was not assessed.

exposures.label: LIPUS after dMCAO (and in sham-operated mice)

target.label: the top of the head of mice

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS applied at 0.5 h after dMCAO and subsequently daily for a stimulation time of 30 min until the mouse was sacrificed; fundamental frequency 1 MHz, stimulation duration 5 min, PRF 1 Hz, duty cycle 5%.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of 372 mice were divided into 4 groups following the principle of randomization (random number): Sham group (n 93); Sham LIPUS group (n 93); dMCAO group (n 93); and dMCAO LIPUS group (n 93).
